picks.editorial_note: A $24.9M NSF grant funds a national self-driving laboratory for metals discovery at Texas A&M, open to researchers nationwide — a major federal investment in autonomous, AI-driven materials science infrastructure.
picks.title: Texas A&M to build self-driving laboratory for metals, open to researchers nationwide – Texas A&M Stories

picks.editorial_note: Northeastern researchers, with DOE and SLAC, built an agentic AI 'scientist' capable of autonomously running experiments — a concrete step toward AI-driven scientific discovery at national-lab scale.
picks.title: This AI scientist can run experiments. Self-driving labs coming next

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's DUNE collaboration is embedding AI across neutrino detector operations, showing how machine learning is becoming core infrastructure for frontier particle physics experiments.
picks.title: DUNE uses AI to transform the future of neutrino research

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's VirTues foundation model analyzes spatial proteomics across many cancer types to predict treatment response — a significant advance toward AI-guided precision oncology.
picks.title: AI model maps tumor tissue to improve cancer care

picks.editorial_note: A sweeping Stony Brook survey of 500+ studies proposes a unified framework for self-improving language models, offering a roadmap for one of AI research's most consequential open problems.
picks.title: Stony Brook Researchers Create a Blueprint for Self-Improving Language Models - SBU News

picks.editorial_note: HappyRobot, founded by TUM alumni, reached unicorn status with its AI phone-automation agents — a marquee commercial validation of university-spawned AI startups.
picks.title: HappyRobot is TUM's 23rd unicorn

picks.editorial_note: A new AI for African Population Health Unit, backed by South Africa's Medical Research Council, signals growing institutional investment in AI tailored to underrepresented health data contexts.
picks.title: New unit a shot in the arm for healthcare research in Africa

picks.editorial_note: UCF's involvement in the DOE's national Genesis Mission highlights a coordinated federal push to build AI models and workflows that accelerate scientific discovery across institutions.
picks.title: UCF Researcher to Support DOE Project Using AI to Accelerate Scientific Discovery

picks.editorial_note: MIT's Omar Khattab, creator of the widely-used DSPy and ColBERT frameworks, now leads an open-source initiative tackling AI's 'last mile' adaptation problem — work with broad downstream influence on how AI systems are built.
picks.title: Solving AI’s ‘Last Mile’ Problem

picks.editorial_note: A DOE Genesis Mission grant funds University of Arkansas research to defend the AI systems managing the U.S. electric grid — a direct link between AI research and critical infrastructure security.
picks.title: DOE Funds U of A Research to Safeguard the AI Behind America's Electric Grid
